rows.grounds: locative plural compound of yoni and yantra

items.question: In how many womb-diagrams are the mothers tormented?
premises: The mothers are tormented within them.
items.inference: The mothers suffer across eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams.
uncertainties: The exact referent of pīḍitāḥ is implicit from context.
Whether yoniyantreṣu denotes diagrams or wombs is interpretive.
items.plain_english: They are tormented in eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams.
